description: Repairs r-wire/create-sql: the SQL route had no cell for the 5,000-character and 4,000-pair Memo values (907, 908) and for FBin 1000 to 1004 and FOle (hex literals were not attempted). Fixture r-fix-wire-ado-sql-extra, created in ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128): table W(ID LONG primary key, FMemo MEMO, FBin BINARY(255), FOle LONGBINARY), then INSERT INTO W (ID, column) VALUES (id, literal) through Database.Execute(dbFailOnError), DBEngine.Errors read right after each: FMemo 907 a 5,000-character literal and 908 a literal of 4,000 surrogate pairs; FBin 1000 the literal 0x, 1001 0x000001, 1002 0x00000000, 1003 a 255-byte hex literal, 1004 a 256-byte hex literal; FOle 1100 0x, 1101 0x000001, 1102 a 256-byte hex literal, 1103 a 5,000-byte hex literal. Then DAO snapshots read each column (field info, every Value once) and GetRows(100) of each. Asks per cell whether the statement succeeds and what is stored, with tag, exact value and length. Not asked: cells with no SQL literal (NaN, infinities, odd-byte BSTRs, the 8,001-byte Memo).
